name: dream-temporal-evolution-cluster
description: Cluster of near-duplicate cold memory pages spanning multiple sessions where an initial pattern and trial-and-error are superseded by an explicit user decision.

cluster_members.body:
## Local Authentication Setup
The backend authentication service runs on port 3000.
We sign local JWT tokens using HMAC-SHA256 with a shared secret.
Configured in `src/auth.rs`.

## Port Binding Conflict
Attempted to change auth service port to 8080 to align with staging.
Failed: port 8080 conflicts with local Docker compose services.
Reverted temporarily to port 3000.

## Asymmetric Key Migration and Official Port
User decision (2026-11-10): Official auth service port for all local and dev services is 8000.
Migrated from symmetric HMAC-SHA256 to asymmetric Ed25519 keypairs so downstream services can verify tokens independently without sharing the signing secret.
Old symmetric secret revoked.
